CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_all_expected_records(selected_revision integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE expected jsonb:='{}';target_revision int;
BEGIN
 -- The no-argument call is the acceptance planner's working basis. Keep the
 -- live definitions and only their source archives, rather than copying the
 -- append-only archive and change log into every successive plan.
 IF selected_revision IS NULL THEN
  WITH head AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1),
  source_coordinates AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT t.definition_rev rev,t.definition_doc_ord ord,t.definition_document_id doc_id FROM truss.type_def t
   UNION SELECT p.definition_rev,p.definition_doc_ord,p.definition_document_id FROM truss.prop_def p
   UNION SELECT k.definition_rev,k.definition_doc_ord,k.definition_document_id
    FROM truss.key_def k
   UNION SELECT r.definition_rev,r.definition_doc_ord,r.definition_document_id FROM truss.rel_def r),
  latest_documents AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.doc_id) d.rev,d.ord,d.doc_id
   FROM truss.schema_doc d
   ORDER BY d.doc_id,d.rev DESC,d.ord DESC),
  needed_documents AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT rev,ord,doc_id FROM source_coordinates UNION SELECT rev,ord,doc_id FROM latest_documents),
  documents AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT d.rev,d.ord,d.doc_id,d.document::jsonb source
   FROM truss.schema_doc d JOIN needed_documents n USING(rev,ord,doc_id)),
  source_elements AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT d.rev,d.ord,d.doc_id,m.value->>'id' module_id,e.value->>'id' element_id,e.value element
   FROM documents d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.source->'modules') m
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(m.value->'elements','[]'::jsonb)) e)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   'schema_rev',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.rev),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM truss.schema_rev r CROSS JOIN head h WHERE r.rev=0 OR r.rev=h.rev),
   'schema_doc',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.rev,d.ord,d.doc_id),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM truss.schema_doc d JOIN needed_documents n USING(rev,ord,doc_id)),
   'type_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.type_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM truss.type_def t),
   'prop_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)||jsonb_build_object('_originalField',e.element) ORDER BY p.prop_id),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM truss.prop_def p JOIN source_elements e ON e.rev=p.definition_rev AND e.ord=p.definition_doc_ord
     AND e.doc_id=p.definition_document_id AND e.module_id=p.declaration_module AND e.element_id=p.element),
   'key_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) ORDER BY k.type_id,k.key_num),'[]'::jsonb) FROM truss.key_def k),
   'rel_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.rel_type_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM truss.rel_def r),
   'relationship_lineage',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l) ORDER BY l.rel_type_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM truss.relationship_lineage l),
   'rel_endpoint',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.rel_type_id,e.source_type,e.target_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM truss.rel_endpoint e),
   'schema_change','[]'::jsonb) INTO expected;
  RETURN expected;
 END IF;
 SELECT greatest(0,least(selected_revision,(SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1)))
  INTO target_revision;
 WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT target_revision rev),
 future_changes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON(c.kind,c.def_id) c.kind,c.def_id,c.before
  FROM truss.schema_change c CROSS JOIN target x WHERE c.rev>x.rev
  ORDER BY c.kind,c.def_id,c.rev,c.seq),
 type_images AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE WHEN c.def_id IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(t) ELSE c.before END value
  FROM truss.type_def t CROSS JOIN target x
  LEFT JOIN future_changes c ON c.kind='type' AND c.def_id=t.type_id
  WHERE t.since_rev<=x.rev),
 property_images AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE WHEN c.def_id IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(p) ELSE c.before END value
  FROM truss.prop_def p CROSS JOIN target x
  LEFT JOIN future_changes c ON c.kind='prop' AND c.def_id=p.prop_id
  WHERE p.since_rev<=x.rev),
 key_images AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT to_jsonb(k) value FROM truss.key_def k CROSS JOIN target x WHERE k.since_rev<=x.rev),
 relation_images AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE WHEN c.def_id IS NULL THEN to_jsonb(r) ELSE c.before END value
  FROM truss.rel_def r CROSS JOIN target x
  LEFT JOIN future_changes c ON c.kind='rel' AND c.def_id=r.rel_type_id
  WHERE r.since_rev<=x.rev),
 needed_documents AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT (p.value->>'definition_rev')::int rev,(p.value->>'definition_doc_ord')::int ord,
   p.value->>'definition_document_id' doc_id FROM property_images p
  UNION
  SELECT (r.value->>'definition_rev')::int,(r.value->>'definition_doc_ord')::int,
   r.value->>'definition_document_id' FROM relation_images r),
 archives AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.rev,d.ord,d.doc_id,d.document::jsonb document FROM truss.schema_doc d
  JOIN needed_documents n USING(rev,ord,doc_id)),
 source_elements AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.rev,d.ord,d.doc_id,m.value->>'id' module_id,e.value->>'id' element_id,e.value element
  FROM archives d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.document->'modules') m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(m.value->'elements','[]'::jsonb)) e),
 source_relationships AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.rev,d.ord,d.doc_id,m.value->>'id' module_id,r.value->>'id' relationship_id,r.value declaration
  FROM archives d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.document->'modules') m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(m.value->'relationships','[]'::jsonb)) r),
 properties_asof AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.value||jsonb_build_object('_originalField',e.element) value
  FROM property_images p JOIN source_elements e
   ON e.rev=(p.value->>'definition_rev')::int AND e.ord=(p.value->>'definition_doc_ord')::int
   AND e.doc_id=p.value->>'definition_document_id' AND e.module_id=p.value->>'declaration_module'
   AND e.element_id=p.value->>'element'),
 relations_asof AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.value,s.declaration FROM relation_images r JOIN source_relationships s
   ON s.rev=(r.value->>'definition_rev')::int AND s.ord=(r.value->>'definition_doc_ord')::int
   AND s.doc_id=r.value->>'definition_document_id' AND s.module_id=r.value->>'module'
   AND s.relationship_id=r.value->>'rel_id'),
 endpoint_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT (r.value->>'rel_type_id')::int rel_type_id,(source_type.value->>'type_id')::int source_type,
   (target_type.value->>'type_id')::int target_type
  FROM relations_asof r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.declaration->'source') source_ref
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.declaration->'target') target_ref
  JOIN type_images source_type ON source_type.value->>'document_id'=r.value->>'document_id'
   AND source_type.value->>'module'=source_ref.value->>'module' AND source_type.value->>'element'=source_ref.value->>'element'
  JOIN type_images target_type ON target_type.value->>'document_id'=r.value->>'document_id'
   AND target_type.value->>'module'=target_ref.value->>'module' AND target_type.value->>'element'=target_ref.value->>'element'),
 lineage_rows AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(l) value FROM truss.relationship_lineage l JOIN relations_asof r
   ON (r.value->>'rel_type_id')::int=l.rel_type_id)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'schema_rev',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.rev),'[]'::jsonb)
   FROM truss.schema_rev r CROSS JOIN target x WHERE r.rev<=x.rev),
  'schema_doc',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.rev,d.ord),'[]'::jsonb)
   FROM truss.schema_doc d CROSS JOIN target x WHERE d.rev<=x.rev),
  'type_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY (value->>'type_id')::int),'[]'::jsonb) FROM type_images),
  'prop_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY (value->>'prop_id')::int),'[]'::jsonb) FROM properties_asof),
  'key_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY (value->>'type_id')::int,(value->>'key_num')::int),'[]'::jsonb) FROM key_images),
  'rel_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY (value->>'rel_type_id')::int),'[]'::jsonb) FROM relation_images),
  'relationship_lineage',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY (value->>'rel_type_id')::int),'[]'::jsonb) FROM lineage_rows),
  'rel_endpoint',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('rel_type_id',rel_type_id,'source_type',source_type,'target_type',target_type)
    ORDER BY rel_type_id,source_type,target_type),'[]'::jsonb) FROM endpoint_rows),
  'schema_change',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.rev,c.seq),'[]'::jsonb)
   FROM truss.schema_change c CROSS JOIN target x WHERE c.rev<=x.rev)) INTO expected;
 RETURN expected;
END;

  FROM truss.prop_def p JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=p.type_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_expected_records(declarations_bytes bytea, documents_bytes bytea, origin_bytes bytea, accepted_clock timestamp with time zone, genesis_clock timestamp with time zone, selected_revision integer DEFAULT 1, type_offset integer DEFAULT 0, property_offset integer DEFAULT 0, relationship_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE validated_declarations jsonb;validated_documents jsonb;validated_origin jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF selected_revision<1 OR type_offset<0 OR property_offset<0 OR relationship_offset<0 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'valid catalog allocation basis required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 validated_declarations:=convert_from(declarations_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 validated_documents:=convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 validated_origin:=convert_from(origin_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF jsonb_typeof(validated_declarations) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_typeof(validated_documents) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(validated_origin) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original record-plan shape required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 RETURN (WITH docs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.value,d.ordinality::int-1 ord
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(validated_documents) WITH ORDINALITY d),
 records AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.value,d.ord,type_offset+row_number() OVER(ORDER BY (r.value->>'documentId') COLLATE "C",(r.value->>'moduleId') COLLATE "C",(r.value->>'elementId') COLLATE "C")::int type_id
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(validated_declarations) a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.value->'records') r JOIN docs d ON d.value->>'documentId'=r.value->>'documentId'),
 type_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.type_id,jsonb_build_object('document_id',r.value->>'documentId','type_id',r.type_id,'module',r.value->>'moduleId',
   'element',r.value->>'elementId','kind','record','provisional',false,'since_rev',selected_revision,'doc_ord',r.ord,
   'lineage_profile','truss-type-lineage/0.1.0','lineage_bytes',chr(92)||'x'||encode(l.bytes,'hex'),
   'lineage_sha256',chr(92)||'x'||encode(sha256(l.bytes),'hex'),'definition_source_kind','accepted_document',
   'definition_rev',selected_revision,'definition_doc_ord',r.ord,'definition_document_id',r.value->>'documentId') value
  FROM records r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT truss.runtime_lineage_bytes('record',r.value->>'documentId',r.value->>'moduleId',r.value->>'elementId') bytes) l),
 field_input AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.type_id,r.ord,r.value->>'documentId' document_id,f.value,
   property_offset+row_number() OVER(ORDER BY (r.value->>'documentId') COLLATE "C",(r.value->>'moduleId') COLLATE "C",
    (r.value->>'elementId') COLLATE "C",(f.value->>'fieldModule') COLLATE "C",(f.value->'declaration'->>'id') COLLATE "C")::int prop_id
  FROM records r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.value->'fields') f),
 item_source_indexes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.value->>'documentId' document_id,
   truss.catalog_item_source_index(d.value->>'originalText') source_index
  FROM docs d
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT document_id COLLATE "C" document_id FROM field_input
        WHERE value->'declaration'->>'cardinality' IN ('array','map')) needed
   ON needed.document_id=d.value->>'documentId' COLLATE "C"),
 prop_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT f.type_id,f.prop_id,f.value->>'fieldModule' field_module,f.value->'declaration'->>'id' element_id,
   jsonb_build_object('prop_id',f.prop_id,'type_id',f.type_id,'element',f.value->'declaration'->>'id',
    'declaration_module',f.value->>'fieldModule','name',coalesce(f.value->'declaration'->>'name',f.value->'declaration'->>'id'),
    'scalar_type',f.value->'declaration'->>'scalarType','nullability',f.value->'declaration'->>'nullability',
    'cardinality',f.value->'declaration'->>'cardinality','facets',f.value->'declaration'->'facets',
    'item',CASE WHEN f.value->'declaration'->>'cardinality' IN ('array','map') THEN truss.catalog_item_definition_indexed(i.source_index,f.document_id,selected_revision,f.ord,f.value->'declaration'->'itemType') ELSE f.value->'declaration'->'itemType' END,
    'home','json','since_rev',selected_revision,'doc_ord',f.ord,'definition_source_kind','accepted_document',
    'definition_rev',selected_revision,'definition_doc_ord',f.ord,'definition_document_id',f.document_id,'_originalField',f.value->'declaration') value
  FROM field_input f
  LEFT JOIN item_source_indexes i ON i.document_id COLLATE "C"=f.document_id COLLATE "C"),
 key_input AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.type_id,r.ord,r.value->>'documentId' document_id,k.value,
   row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY r.type_id ORDER BY (k.value->>'id') COLLATE "C")::int key_num
  FROM records r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.value->'keys') k),
 key_components AS (
  SELECT k.type_id,k.key_num,jsonb_agg(p.prop_id ORDER BY ref.ordinality) ids
  FROM key_input k CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(k.value->'fields') WITH ORDINALITY ref
  JOIN prop_rows p ON p.type_id=k.type_id AND p.field_module=ref.value->>'module' AND p.element_id=ref.value->>'element'
  GROUP BY k.type_id,k.key_num),
 key_rows AS (
  SELECT k.type_id,k.key_num,jsonb_build_object('type_id',k.type_id,'key_id',k.value->>'id','key_num',k.key_num,
   'prop_ids',coalesce(c.ids,'[]'::jsonb),'is_primary',coalesce((k.value->>'primary')::boolean,false),'since_rev',selected_revision,
   'definition_source_kind','accepted_document','definition_rev',selected_revision,'definition_doc_ord',k.ord,'definition_document_id',k.document_id) value
  FROM key_input k LEFT JOIN key_components c USING(type_id,key_num)),
 rel_input AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.value,d.ord,relationship_offset+row_number() OVER(ORDER BY (r.value->>'documentId') COLLATE "C",(r.value->>'moduleId') COLLATE "C",(r.value->'declaration'->>'id') COLLATE "C")::int rel_type_id
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(validated_declarations) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.value->'relationships') r
  JOIN docs d ON d.value->>'documentId'=r.value->>'documentId'),
 rel_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.rel_type_id,jsonb_build_object('document_id',r.value->>'documentId','rel_type_id',r.rel_type_id,'module',r.value->>'moduleId',
   'rel_id',r.value->'declaration'->>'id','name',r.value->'declaration'->>'name',
   'source_min',(r.value->'declaration'->'sourceMultiplicity'->>'min')::int,'source_max',nullif(r.value->'declaration'->'sourceMultiplicity'->>'max','*')::int,
   'target_min',(r.value->'declaration'->'targetMultiplicity'->>'min')::int,'target_max',nullif(r.value->'declaration'->'targetMultiplicity'->>'max','*')::int,
   'lifecycle',r.value->'declaration'->>'targetLifecycle','directed',(r.value->'declaration'->>'directed')::boolean,
   'target_key',(r.value->'declaration'->'target'->-1)->>'key','composition',false,'since_rev',selected_revision,'doc_ord',r.ord,
   'definition_source_kind','accepted_document','definition_rev',selected_revision,'definition_doc_ord',r.ord,'definition_document_id',r.value->>'documentId') value
  FROM rel_input r),
 lineage_rows AS (
  SELECT r.rel_type_id,jsonb_build_object('rel_type_id',r.rel_type_id,'lineage_category','authored','identity_profile','truss-relationship-lineage-bytes/0.1.0',
   'original_identity_bytes',chr(92)||'x'||encode(l.bytes,'hex'),'identity_sha256',chr(92)||'x'||encode(sha256(l.bytes),'hex')) value
  FROM rel_input r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT truss.runtime_lineage_bytes('authored',r.value->>'documentId',r.value->>'moduleId',r.value->'declaration'->>'id') bytes) l),
 endpoint_rows AS (
  SELECT r.rel_type_id,s.ordinality source_ord,t.ordinality target_ord,
   jsonb_build_object('rel_type_id',r.rel_type_id,'source_type',sr.type_id,'target_type',tr.type_id) value
  FROM rel_input r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.value->'declaration'->'source') WITH ORDINALITY s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.value->'declaration'->'target') WITH ORDINALITY t
  JOIN records sr ON sr.value->>'documentId'=r.value->>'documentId' AND sr.value->>'moduleId'=s.value->>'module' AND sr.value->>'elementId'=s.value->>'element'
  JOIN records tr ON tr.value->>'documentId'=r.value->>'documentId' AND tr.value->>'moduleId'=t.value->>'module' AND tr.value->>'elementId'=t.value->>'element')
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'schema_rev',CASE WHEN selected_revision=1 THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('rev',0,'accepted_at',genesis_clock,'origin','{}'::jsonb)) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
   ||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('rev',selected_revision,'accepted_at',accepted_clock,'origin',validated_origin)),
  'schema_doc',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('rev',selected_revision,'ord',d.ord,'doc_id',d.value->>'documentId','doc_revision',d.value->>'revision',
   'umf_version',d.value->>'umfVersion','content_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(d.value->>'originalText','UTF8')),'hex'),'document',d.value->>'originalText','validation',d.value->'validation') ORDER BY d.ord),'[]'::jsonb) FROM docs d),
  'type_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY type_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM type_rows),
  'prop_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY prop_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM prop_rows),
  'key_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY type_id,key_num),'[]'::jsonb) FROM key_rows),
  'rel_def',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY rel_type_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM rel_rows),
  'relationship_lineage',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY rel_type_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM lineage_rows),
  'rel_endpoint',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY rel_type_id,source_ord,target_ord),'[]'::jsonb) FROM endpoint_rows)));
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.grant_import_audit_access(selected_document text, selected_module text, selected_auditor_role text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor record;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;auditor oid;has_owner boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT r.oid,r.rolcanlogin,r.rolsuper,r.rolcreaterole,r.rolcreatedb,r.rolreplication,r.rolbypassrls,
  current_setting('role')='none' AS original_role INTO STRICT actor
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=session_user;
 IF selected_document IS NULL OR selected_module IS NULL OR selected_auditor_role IS NULL
  OR octet_length(selected_document) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
  OR octet_length(selected_module) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
  OR octet_length(selected_auditor_role) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
  OR actor.rolcanlogin IS NOT TRUE OR actor.original_role IS NOT TRUE
  OR NOT actor.rolsuper AND (NOT actor.rolcreaterole OR actor.rolcreatedb
   OR actor.rolreplication OR actor.rolbypassrls) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'qualified direct installation administrator and audit role required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.catalog_runtime_installation WHERE singleton;
 IF NOT actor.rolsuper THEN
  WITH RECURSIVE inherited(role_oid) AS (
   SELECT actor.oid UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m
    JOIN inherited i ON m.member=i.role_oid WHERE m.inherit_option)
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inherited WHERE role_oid=installation.owner_oid) INTO has_owner;
  IF has_owner IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'installation owner administration required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT r.oid INTO auditor FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=selected_auditor_role
  AND NOT r.rolcanlogin AND NOT r.rolsuper AND NOT r.rolcreatedb AND NOT r.rolcreaterole
  AND NOT r.rolreplication AND NOT r.rolbypassrls AND NOT r.rolinherit;
 IF auditor IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.module_access m
  WHERE m.document_id=selected_document AND m.module=selected_module
   AND m.reader_role IS DISTINCT FROM selected_auditor_role
   AND m.writer_role IS DISTINCT FROM selected_auditor_role) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'configured module audit role required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 INSERT INTO truss.runtime_import_audit_access(document_id,module,auditor_oid,granted_by)
  VALUES(selected_document,selected_module,auditor,actor.oid)
  ON CONFLICT(document_id,module) DO UPDATE SET auditor_oid=EXCLUDED.auditor_oid,granted_by=EXCLUDED.granted_by;
 RETURN convert_to('{"outcome":"granted"}','UTF8');
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.page_mutation_group_audit(filters jsonb, maximum_events integer, original_cursor bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor oid;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;filter_sha text;
 cursor_value jsonb;frontier xid8;last_observed timestamptz;last_attempt uuid;candidate record;
 group_bytes bytea;group_value jsonb;cursor_bytes bytea;key_filter jsonb;release_check bytea;
BEGIN
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a
   WHERE truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current mutation audit enrollment required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 IF filters IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(filters) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR filters-ARRAY['attemptId','documentId','moduleId','entityId','entityType','entityKey','nativeActorOid',
    'assertedAction','observedAtFrom','observedAtUntil']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR octet_length(convert_to(filters::text,'UTF8'))>65536
  OR maximum_events IS NULL OR maximum_events NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded mutation-group audit listing required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF filters ? 'attemptId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'attemptId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'attemptId' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
  OR (filters ? 'documentId') IS NOT TRUE OR (filters ? 'moduleId') IS NOT TRUE
  OR filters ? 'entityId' AND (filters ? 'entityType') IS NOT TRUE
  OR filters ? 'nativeActorOid' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'nativeActorOid') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'nativeActorOid' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$' OR (filters->>'nativeActorOid')::numeric>4294967295)
  OR filters ? 'entityId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'entityId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$')
  OR filters ? 'entityType' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityType') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'entityType' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$')
  OR filters ? 'entityKey' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR (filters->'entityKey')-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId','typeId','keyNumber','definitionPin','values']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->'entityKey'->>'documentId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->'entityKey'->>'moduleId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->'entityKey'->>'typeId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$'
   OR (filters->'entityKey'->>'typeId')::numeric>2147483647
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'keyNumber') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->'entityKey'->>'keyNumber' !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,4})$'
   OR (filters->'entityKey'->>'keyNumber')::numeric>32767
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'definitionPin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->'entityKey'->>'definitionPin') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'values') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(filters->'entityKey'->'values') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128)
  OR filters ? 'documentId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->>'documentId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
  OR filters ? 'moduleId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->>'moduleId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
  OR filters ? 'assertedAction' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'assertedAction') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->>'assertedAction') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
  OR filters ? 'observedAtFrom' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'observedAtFrom') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'observedAtFrom' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$')
  OR filters ? 'observedAtUntil' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'observedAtUntil') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'observedAtUntil' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical bounded mutation audit filters required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a
   WHERE a.document_id=filters->>'documentId' AND a.module=filters->>'moduleId'
    AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'qualified mutation audit module enrollment required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 IF filters ? 'assertedAction' AND octet_length(convert_to(filters->>'assertedAction','UTF8'))>4096 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded mutation audit action required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF filters ? 'observedAtFrom' AND filters ? 'observedAtUntil' THEN
  BEGIN
   IF (filters->>'observedAtFrom')::timestamptz >= (filters->>'observedAtUntil')::timestamptz THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ordered observed-time range required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22007' OR SQLSTATE '22008' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical mutation audit time range required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END;
 END IF;
 IF filters ? 'entityKey' THEN
  key_filter:=filters->'entityKey';
  IF jsonb_typeof(key_filter) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR key_filter-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId','typeId','keyNumber','definitionPin','values']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR key_filter->>'typeId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$'
   OR length(key_filter->>'typeId')=10 AND key_filter->>'typeId' COLLATE "C">'2147483647'
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'keyNumber') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR key_filter->>'keyNumber' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$'
   OR (key_filter->>'keyNumber')::int>32767
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'definitionPin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR key_filter->>'definitionPin' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'values') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(key_filter->'values') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact archived entity-key filter required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  IF key_filter->>'documentId' IS DISTINCT FROM filters->>'documentId'
   OR key_filter->>'moduleId' IS DISTINCT FROM filters->>'moduleId' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'entity-key and module listing scopes must agree' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 END IF;
 IF octet_length(convert_to(filters::text,'UTF8'))>16384 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'mutation audit filters exceed limits' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
  OR pg_is_in_recovery() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current mutation audit release required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 filter_sha:=encode(sha256(convert_to(filters::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
 frontier:=pg_catalog.pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_catalog.pg_current_snapshot());
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a
   WHERE a.complete AND a.writer_xid<frontier AND a.audit_observed_at IS NULL
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p WHERE p.attempt_id=a.id AND p.writer_xid=a.writer_xid
     AND jsonb_path_exists(p.plan,'$.** ? (@.documentId == $document && @.moduleId == $module)',
      jsonb_build_object('document',to_jsonb(filters->>'documentId'),'module',to_jsonb(filters->>'moduleId'))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained mutation group has no truthful observation time' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
 IF original_cursor IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF octet_length(original_cursor) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
   OR (convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded exact mutation audit cursor required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  cursor_value:=convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF cursor_value-ARRAY['profile','installationId','sourceEpoch','releaseId','releaseSha256','frontierXid',
      'filtersSha256','afterObservedAt','afterAttemptId']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR cursor_value->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-mutation-group-audit-cursor/0.2'
   OR cursor_value->>'installationId' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.installation_id::text
   OR cursor_value->>'sourceEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.source_epoch::text
   OR cursor_value->>'releaseId' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release
   OR cursor_value->>'releaseSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
   OR cursor_value->>'filtersSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM filter_sha
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'frontierXid') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR cursor_value->>'frontierXid' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
   OR (cursor_value->>'frontierXid')::numeric>18446744073709551615
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'afterObservedAt') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR cursor_value->>'afterObservedAt' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{6}Z$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'afterAttemptId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR cursor_value->>'afterAttemptId' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current mutation audit cursor context required' USING ERRCODE='P1002';END IF;
  frontier:=(cursor_value->>'frontierXid')::xid8;
  BEGIN last_observed:=(cursor_value->>'afterObservedAt')::timestamptz;
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22007' OR SQLSTATE '22008' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical mutation audit cursor timestamp required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END;
  last_attempt:=(cursor_value->>'afterAttemptId')::uuid;
  IF cursor_value IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(truss.runtime_mutation_audit_cursor(
    installation.installation_id,installation.source_epoch,expected_release,expected_digest,
    frontier,filter_sha,last_observed,last_attempt),'UTF8')::jsonb
   OR frontier>pg_catalog.pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_catalog.pg_current_snapshot()) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact frozen mutation audit cursor required' USING ERRCODE='P1002';END IF;
 ELSE
  last_observed:='infinity'::timestamptz;last_attempt:='ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid;
 END IF;
 FOR candidate IN SELECT a.id,a.writer_xid,a.audit_observed_at FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a
  WHERE a.complete AND a.writer_xid<frontier
   AND a.audit_observed_at IS NOT NULL
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p WHERE p.attempt_id=a.id AND p.writer_xid=a.writer_xid
    AND jsonb_path_exists(p.plan,'$.** ? (@.documentId == $document && @.moduleId == $module)',
     jsonb_build_object('document',to_jsonb(filters->>'documentId'),'module',to_jsonb(filters->>'moduleId'))))
   AND (original_cursor IS NULL OR (a.audit_observed_at,a.id)<(last_observed,last_attempt))
   AND (NOT filters ? 'attemptId' OR a.id=(filters->>'attemptId')::uuid)
   AND (NOT filters ? 'nativeActorOid' OR a.actor_oid=(filters->>'nativeActorOid')::oid)
  ORDER BY a.audit_observed_at DESC,a.id DESC LOOP
  -- Authorize and validate the complete original owner union before applying
  -- identity or business-key filters that inspect retained private values.
  group_bytes:=truss.read_mutation_group_audit(candidate.id,maximum_events,expected_release,expected_digest);
  group_value:=convert_from(group_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF filters ? 'documentId' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(group_value->'ownerScopes') scope(value)
    WHERE scope.value->>'documentId'=filters->>'documentId' AND scope.value->>'moduleId'=filters->>'moduleId') THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  IF truss.runtime_mutation_audit_attempt_matches(candidate.id,filters) IS NOT TRUE THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  cursor_bytes:=truss.runtime_mutation_audit_cursor(installation.installation_id,
    installation.source_epoch,expected_release,expected_digest,frontier,filter_sha,
    candidate.audit_observed_at,candidate.id);
  -- The collector checks the complete historical owner union. Re-run it after
  -- cursor/projection work so revocation during page assembly cannot release
  -- a group on the strength of an earlier membership observation.
  release_check:=truss.read_mutation_group_audit(candidate.id,maximum_events,expected_release,expected_digest);
  PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
  RETURN convert_to((group_value||jsonb_build_object('nextPageCursor',convert_from(cursor_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb))::text,'UTF8');
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a
   WHERE a.document_id=filters->>'documentId' AND a.module=filters->>'moduleId'
    AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'mutation audit module authority changed before empty-page release' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 RETURN convert_to('{"outcome":"end","nextPageCursor":null}','UTF8');
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_create_commit_check()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='object' THEN
  -- The canonical owned attempt settles its writes once. Match this queued
  -- create header; legacy profiles retain their separate member validator.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t JOIN truss.runtime_object_attempt a ON a.id=t.attempt_id
   WHERE t.object_id=NEW.id AND t.type_id=NEW.type_id AND t.before_object IS NULL
    AND t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND a.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND a.complete
    AND a.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile()
    AND t.after_object->>'ver'=NEW.ver::text AND t.after_object->>'rev'=NEW.rev::text
    AND t.after_object->'root_id'=coalesce(to_jsonb(NEW.root_id),'null'::jsonb)
    AND t.after_object->'root_type'=coalesce(to_jsonb(NEW.root_type),'null'::jsonb)) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 -- Trusted administrators may seed private read fixtures; they cannot call the
 -- ordinary-person mutation facade. This is not an ordinary-caller bypass.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user AND rolsuper) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='object' THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t JOIN truss.runtime_object_attempt a ON a.id=t.attempt_id
   WHERE t.object_id=NEW.id AND t.type_id=NEW.type_id AND t.before_object IS NULL
    AND t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND a.context->'creationTransitionProfile'='{"identity":"truss-unified-create-transition","version":"0.2","sha256":"073782e2517f2a7e26c8d6479c6266ececf68963681ccfb6a380e9cd16f2e11b"}'::jsonb) THEN
   PERFORM truss.runtime_object_validate(NEW.id,NEW.type_id);
  ELSE PERFORM truss.runtime_create_validate_member(NEW.id,NEW.type_id);END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='runtime_create_group' THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_create_validate_group(NEW.group_id);
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'registered create commit event required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END;

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE affected record;current_actor oid;
BEGIN
 current_actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 FOR affected IN
  SELECT DISTINCT object_id,type_id FROM (
   SELECT m.object_id,m.type_id FROM truss.runtime_create_member m JOIN truss.runtime_create_group g USING(group_id) WHERE g.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   UNION ALL SELECT object_id,type_id FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   UNION ALL SELECT object_id,type_id FROM truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition WHERE writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   UNION ALL SELECT object_id,type_id FROM truss.runtime_catalog_key_backfill WHERE writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   UNION ALL SELECT o.id,o.type_id FROM truss.object o
    JOIN truss.rel_endpoint e ON o.type_id IN(e.source_type,e.target_type)
    JOIN (SELECT rel_type_id,since_rev rev FROM truss.rel_def
     UNION SELECT def_id,rev FROM truss.schema_change WHERE kind='rel') c ON c.rel_type_id=e.rel_type_id
    JOIN truss.catalog_registration_request r ON r.revision=c.rev
    WHERE r.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   UNION ALL SELECT (i.value->>'id')::bigint,(i.value->>'typeId')::int FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(t.old_source,t.old_target,t.source_identity,t.target_identity)) i
    WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND i.value<>'null'::jsonb) o ORDER BY object_id,type_id LOOP
  PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate_object_qualified(affected.object_id,affected.type_id,refresh_markers,current_actor);
 END LOOP;

BEGIN

 FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation WHERE attempt_id=attempt.id AND operation_index=total-1;

  OR attempt.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR attempt.actor_oid IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR input->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile()
  OR final_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1)

  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE attempt_id=attempt.id)<>total
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition WHERE attempt_id=attempt.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original create effect inventory required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT t.type_id,t.document_id,t.module FROM truss.runtime_object_transition x JOIN truss.type_def t USING(type_id)
  WHERE x.attempt_id=attempt.id LOOP
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(owner.document_id,owner.module,actor);
  IF NOT truss.runtime_object_values_readable_qualified(owner.type_id,actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original property readers required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 END LOOP;

 -- them. Settlement keeps freshness, effect inventory and current distinct
 -- owner authority without reconstructing each trusted operation's semantics.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_owned_graph_validate_attempt(selected_attempt uuid, refresh_markers boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE affected record;current_actor oid;affected_members jsonb;owner record;phase int;
BEGIN
 current_actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF refresh_markers IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a
  WHERE a.id=selected_attempt AND a.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND a.actor_oid=current_actor) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original graph attempt required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY object_id,type_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO affected_members FROM (SELECT DISTINCT object_id,type_id FROM (
   SELECT object_id,type_id FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE attempt_id=selected_attempt
    AND (before_object-ARRAY['props','retained','ver','created_at','updated_at'])
      IS DISTINCT FROM (after_object-ARRAY['props','retained','ver','created_at','updated_at'])
   UNION ALL SELECT (i.value->>'id')::bigint,(i.value->>'typeId')::int
    FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t CROSS JOIN LATERAL
     jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(t.old_source,t.old_target,t.source_identity,t.target_identity)) i
    WHERE t.attempt_id=selected_attempt AND i.value<>'null'::jsonb) members) m;
 IF affected_members='[]'::jsonb THEN RETURN;END IF;
 -- No per-object count can constrain an entirely unbounded incident graph.
 -- Qualify that case as a set, retaining live row locks, both current-reader
 -- phases, and exact empty-marker effects. Any bounded relation stays on the
 -- original per-object path, including bounds on the opposite endpoint side.
 PERFORM 1 FROM truss.object o
  JOIN jsonb_to_recordset(affected_members) a(object_id bigint,type_id int)
   ON o.id=a.object_id AND o.type_id=a.type_id
  ORDER BY o.id,o.type_id FOR UPDATE OF o NOWAIT;
 IF NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_to_recordset(affected_members) a(object_id bigint,type_id int)
  JOIN truss.object o ON o.id=a.object_id AND o.type_id=a.type_id
  JOIN truss.rel_endpoint e ON e.source_type=o.type_id OR e.target_type=o.type_id
  JOIN truss.rel_def r USING(rel_type_id)
  WHERE r.retired_rev IS NULL AND
   (r.source_min>0 OR r.target_min>0 OR r.source_max IS NOT NULL OR r.target_max IS NOT NULL)) THEN
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 FOR affected IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(affected_members) a(object_id bigint,type_id int)
  ORDER BY object_id,type_id LOOP
  PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate_object_qualified(affected.object_id,affected.type_id,refresh_markers,current_actor);
 END LOOP;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_owned_group_validate(selected_attempt uuid, check_final boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;current_actor oid;initial_scope jsonb;
 owner record;source_cut record;history_basis jsonb;root_type int;selected_revision int;
 operation_count int;missing_results int;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=selected_attempt;
 current_actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF check_final IS NULL OR NOT attempt.complete
  OR attempt.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR attempt.actor_oid IS DISTINCT FROM current_actor
  OR attempt.result_count IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.next_index THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete current owned group required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER(WHERE result IS NULL)
 INTO operation_count,missing_results FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation WHERE attempt_id=selected_attempt;
 IF operation_count<>attempt.next_index OR missing_results<>0 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete owned operation results required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT plan->'initialScope',(plan->>'catalogRevision')::int INTO STRICT initial_scope,selected_revision
 FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation WHERE attempt_id=selected_attempt AND operation_index=0;
 -- At finish this is the executing revision. A later accepted revision in the
 -- same outer transaction may supersede it; commit retains historical readers.
 IF check_final AND selected_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current finishing catalog revision required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 -- Include original component owners and actual selected resources. No-op
 -- results have no transition but still require their original current writer.
 FOR owner IN
  SELECT DISTINCT document_id,module_id FROM (
   SELECT r.value->'identity'->'owner'->>'documentId' document_id,r.value->'identity'->'owner'->>'moduleId' module_id
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(attempt.results) r
   UNION ALL SELECT d.document_id,d.module FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t JOIN truss.type_def d USING(type_id)
    WHERE t.attempt_id=selected_attempt
   UNION ALL SELECT d.document_id,d.module FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t JOIN truss.rel_def d USING(rel_type_id)
    WHERE t.attempt_id=selected_attempt
  ) dependencies
 LOOP
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(owner.document_id,owner.module_id,current_actor);
 END LOOP;
 FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT document_id,module_id FROM (
  SELECT value->'definition'->>'document_id' document_id,value->'definition'->>'module' module_id FROM jsonb_each(initial_scope->'boundary')
  UNION ALL SELECT d.document_id,d.module FROM jsonb_each(initial_scope->'nodes') n JOIN truss.type_def d ON d.type_id=(n.value->>'type_id')::int
  UNION ALL SELECT d.document_id,d.module FROM jsonb_each(initial_scope->'edges') e JOIN truss.rel_def d ON d.rel_type_id=(e.value->>'rel_type_id')::int
 ) observed_readers LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(owner.document_id,owner.module_id,current_actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current boundary reader required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Executed object types (including no-ops) use the compiled dependency
 -- union once per revision/type, rather than one authorization program per row.
 FOR owner IN
  WITH selected_types AS (
   SELECT DISTINCT (r.value->'identity'->>'typeId')::int type_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(attempt.results) r
    WHERE r.value->>'operation' IN ('create_object','update_object','delete_object')
   UNION SELECT type_id FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE attempt_id=selected_attempt)
  SELECT DISTINCT r.value->>'documentId' document_id,r.value->>'moduleId' module_id
  FROM selected_types t JOIN truss.runtime_type_schema s ON s.type_id=t.type_id AND s.rev=selected_revision
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.value_readers) r
 LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(owner.document_id,owner.module_id,current_actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current executed property/item reader required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Check historical property/item dependencies from actual captured images,
 -- including no-op sources, without reconstructing any history payload.
 FOR source_cut IN
  WITH selected_types AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT DISTINCT (r.value->'identity'->>'typeId')::int type_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(attempt.results) r
    WHERE r.value->>'operation' IN ('create_object','update_object','delete_object')
   UNION SELECT type_id FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE attempt_id=selected_attempt),
  images AS (
   SELECT value image FROM jsonb_each(initial_scope->'nodes')
   UNION ALL SELECT before_object FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE attempt_id=selected_attempt AND before_object IS NOT NULL
   UNION ALL SELECT after_object FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE attempt_id=selected_attempt AND after_object IS NOT NULL)
  SELECT (image->>'type_id')::int type_id,(image->>'rev')::int revision,
   coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT p.name) FILTER(WHERE p.name IS NOT NULL),'{}'::text[]) present_names
  FROM images LEFT JOIN selected_types t ON t.type_id=(image->>'type_id')::int
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(image->'props') p(name) ON true
  WHERE (image->>'rev')::int<>selected_revision OR t.type_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY (image->>'type_id')::int,(image->>'rev')::int
 LOOP
  SELECT metadata INTO STRICT history_basis FROM truss.runtime_type_schema
   WHERE rev=source_cut.revision AND type_id=source_cut.type_id;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(source_cut.present_names) p(name)
   WHERE (history_basis->'propertyAccess') ? p.name
    AND history_basis->'propertyAccess'->p.name->'itemsValid' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current historical property/item readers required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
  FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT r.value->>'documentId' document_id,r.value->>'moduleId' module_id
   FROM unnest(source_cut.present_names) p(name)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(history_basis->'propertyAccess'->p.name->'readers') r LOOP
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(owner.document_id,owner.module_id,current_actor) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'current historical property/item readers required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 -- Root identity authorization is independent of reading an endpoint's type.
 FOR root_type IN
  SELECT DISTINCT roots.root_type FROM (
   SELECT (value->>'root_type')::int root_type FROM jsonb_each(initial_scope->'nodes')
   UNION ALL SELECT (image->>'root_type')::int FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(t.before_object),(t.after_object)) v(image) WHERE t.attempt_id=selected_attempt
  ) roots WHERE roots.root_type IS NOT NULL
 LOOP
  SELECT document_id,module AS module_id INTO STRICT owner FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=root_type;
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(owner.document_id,owner.module_id,current_actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current captured root reader required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_edge_authorize(selected_attempt);
END;

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'

AS $function$
DECLARE properties jsonb:='[]';retained jsonb;missing_pin boolean;
 object_properties jsonb:=object_image->'props';property_pins jsonb:=metadata->'propertyPins';
BEGIN

  OR metadata->>'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM object_image->>'rev'
  OR jsonb_typeof(metadata->'typePin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'

    'definitionPin',property_pins->property_id,'value',object_properties->property_id)
    ORDER BY ordinality),'[]'::jsonb),

 FROM (SELECT entry#>>'{}' property_id,ordinality
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(metadata->'propertyOrder') WITH ORDINALITY ordered(entry,ordinality)) selected
 WHERE object_properties ? property_id;
 IF missing_pin THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original history property pins required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',key,'value',value) ORDER BY key COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) INTO retained FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(nullif(object_image->'retained','null'::jsonb),'{}'));
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-history-record/0.1.0','kind','object','identity',identity,
  'recordVersion',object_image->>'ver','catalogRevision',object_image->>'rev',
  'createdAt',to_char((object_image->>'created_at')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'updatedAt',to_char((object_image->>'updated_at')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  'properties',properties,'retained',retained,'ownership',truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(object_image));
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_owned_history_records_in_metadata(object_batch jsonb, metadata_dictionary jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE projection jsonb;has_missing_pin boolean;has_invalid_metadata boolean;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(object_batch) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(metadata_dictionary) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original batch history metadata required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(object_batch)>64 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded batch history projection required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(object_batch) o
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(o.value->'before'),(o.value->'after')) images(image)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT metadata_dictionary->
   jsonb_build_array((images.image->>'rev')::int,(images.image->>'type_id')::int)::text metadata) m
  WHERE o.value->'changed'='true'::jsonb AND
   (m.metadata->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM images.image->>'type_id'
    OR m.metadata->>'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM images.image->>'rev'
    OR jsonb_typeof(m.metadata->'typePin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
    OR jsonb_typeof(m.metadata->'propertyOrder') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_typeof(m.metadata->'propertyPins') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original compiled history metadata required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 WITH batch AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT (o.value->>'index')::int operation_index,o.value->'identity' identity,
   o.value->'before' before_image,o.value->'after' after_image
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(object_batch) o
  WHERE o.value->'changed'='true'::jsonb),
 image_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT operation_index,identity,'before'::text image_side,before_image image FROM batch
  UNION ALL
  SELECT operation_index,identity,'after'::text image_side,after_image image FROM batch),
 image_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT i.*,metadata_dictionary->jsonb_build_array((image->>'rev')::int,(image->>'type_id')::int)::text metadata,
   (image->>'rev')::int revision,(image->>'type_id')::int type_id
  FROM image_rows i),
 metadata_basis AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT revision,type_id FROM image_metadata),
 property_order AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT b.revision,b.type_id,m.metadata->'typePin' type_pin,
   entry.value#>>'{}' property_id,entry.ordinality,
   m.metadata->'propertyPins'->(entry.value#>>'{}') definition_pin,
   (m.metadata->'propertyPins') ? (entry.value#>>'{}') pin_present
  FROM metadata_basis b CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT metadata_dictionary->
    jsonb_build_array(b.revision,b.type_id)::text metadata) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL
   jsonb_array_elements(m.metadata->'propertyOrder') WITH ORDINALITY entry(value,ordinality)
 ),
 property_values AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT i.operation_index,i.image_side,p.property_id,p.ordinality,p.definition_pin,p.pin_present,cell.value
  FROM image_metadata i CROSS JOIN LATERAL
   jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(i.image->'props')='object' THEN i.image->'props' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) cell
  JOIN property_order p ON p.revision=i.revision AND p.type_id=i.type_id AND p.property_id=cell.key),
 property_arrays AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT i.operation_index,i.image_side,
   coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('propertyId',p.property_id,
    'definitionPin',p.definition_pin,'value',p.value)
    ORDER BY p.ordinality) FILTER (WHERE p.property_id IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb) properties,
   coalesce(bool_or(NOT p.pin_present) FILTER (WHERE p.property_id IS NOT NULL),false) missing_pin
  FROM image_metadata i LEFT JOIN property_values p USING(operation_index,image_side)
  GROUP BY i.operation_index,i.image_side),
 image_properties AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT i.*,a.properties,a.missing_pin
  FROM image_metadata i JOIN property_arrays a USING(operation_index,image_side)),
 checked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT *,
   (metadata->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM type_id::text
    OR metadata->>'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM revision::text
    OR jsonb_typeof(metadata->'typePin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
    OR jsonb_typeof(metadata->'propertyOrder') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_typeof(metadata->'propertyPins') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object') metadata_invalid
  FROM image_properties),
 records AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT operation_index,image_side,missing_pin,metadata_invalid,
   jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-history-record/0.1.0','kind','object',
    'identity',jsonb_set(identity,'{definitionPin}',metadata->'typePin'),
    'recordVersion',image->>'ver','catalogRevision',image->>'rev',
    'createdAt',to_char((image->>'created_at')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
    'updatedAt',to_char((image->>'updated_at')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
    'properties',properties,
    'retained',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',key,'value',value) ORDER BY key COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb)
     FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(nullif(image->'retained','null'::jsonb),'{}'::jsonb))),
    'ownership',truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(image)) record_image
  FROM checked),
 pairs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT operation_index,
   jsonb_object_agg(image_side,record_image) FILTER (WHERE image_side IN ('before','after')) images,
   count(*) image_count,
   coalesce(bool_or(missing_pin),false) missing_pin,
   coalesce(bool_or(metadata_invalid IS TRUE),false) metadata_invalid
  FROM records GROUP BY operation_index)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(operation_index::text,images),'{}'::jsonb),
  coalesce(bool_or(missing_pin),false),coalesce(bool_or(metadata_invalid OR image_count<>2),false)
 INTO projection,has_missing_pin,has_invalid_metadata FROM pairs;
 IF has_invalid_metadata THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original compiled history metadata required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF has_missing_pin THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original history property pins required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 RETURN coalesce(projection,'{}'::jsonb);
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_owned_index_definition_source()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 WITH modules AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT value->>'id' module_id,value->'elements' module_elements,value->'relationships' module_relationships,ordinality::int-1 mi
  FROM json_array_elements(NEW.document::json->'modules') WITH ORDINALITY),
 elements AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT m.module_id,e.value element,e.value->>'id' element_id,'element' kind,
   '/modules/'||m.mi||'/elements/'||(e.ordinality-1) pointer
  FROM modules m CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_array_elements(m.module_elements) WITH ORDINALITY e
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.module_id,e.value,e.value->>'id','relationship',
   '/modules/'||m.mi||'/relationships/'||(e.ordinality-1)
  FROM modules m CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_array_elements(m.module_relationships) WITH ORDINALITY e),
 fragments AS (
  SELECT module_id,element_id,kind,'' key_id,pointer,convert_to(element::text,'UTF8') fragment FROM elements
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.module_id,e.element_id,'key',k.value->>'id',e.pointer||'/keys/'||(k.ordinality-1),convert_to(k.value::text,'UTF8')
  FROM elements e CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_array_elements(e.element->'keys') WITH ORDINALITY k WHERE e.kind='element')
 INSERT INTO truss.runtime_definition_source
 SELECT NEW.rev,NEW.ord,NEW.doc_id,module_id,element_id,kind,key_id,pointer,
  encode(sha256(convert_to('['||NEW.rev||','||NEW.ord||',"'||NEW.content_sha256||'","'||pointer
  ||'",{"identity":"truss-original-json-definition","sha256":"08c2ec8c520b39ded40f270be0b26812db1d240d5bac1a00339b437200a2f58d","version":"0.1"},"'
  ||encode(sha256(fragment),'hex')||'"]','UTF8')),'hex') FROM fragments;
 RETURN NULL;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_owned_index_type_schema()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE basis jsonb;current_head boolean;compiled_records jsonb[]:='{}';missing_pins boolean;document_row record;records jsonb;relations jsonb;readers jsonb;closed boolean;items_valid boolean;
BEGIN
 -- The accepted head already contains the installed, validated native rows.
 -- Historical initialization retains its original reconstruction; the current
 -- revision does not parse and rebuild the complete catalog a second time.
 current_head:=NEW.rev=(SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.schema_rev WHERE rev>NEW.rev);
 IF NOT current_head THEN basis:=truss.catalog_all_expected_records(NEW.rev);END IF;
 -- Compile the entire revision as one typed relation. Every source/native
 -- check below is the same check as the former per-type statement loop.
 WITH types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT t.* FROM truss.type_def t WHERE current_head AND t.kind='record' AND NOT t.provisional AND (t.retired_rev IS NULL OR t.retired_rev>NEW.rev)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.* FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.type_def,basis->'type_def') t
  WHERE NOT current_head AND t.kind='record' AND NOT t.provisional AND (t.retired_rev IS NULL OR t.retired_rev>NEW.rev)),
 properties AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.* FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE current_head
  UNION ALL SELECT p.* FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.prop_def,basis->'prop_def') p WHERE NOT current_head),
 keys AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k.* FROM truss.key_def k WHERE current_head
  UNION ALL SELECT k.* FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.key_def,basis->'key_def') k WHERE NOT current_head),
 documents AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON(doc_id) doc_id,doc_revision,umf_version,document::jsonb source
  FROM truss.schema_doc WHERE rev<=NEW.rev ORDER BY doc_id,rev DESC),
 elements AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.doc_id,d.umf_version,m.value->>'id' module_id,e.value->>'id' element_id,e.value element
  FROM documents d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.source->'modules') m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.value->'elements') e),
 authored_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k.type_id,k.key_num,k.prop_ids,t.document_id,r.umf_version,r.element record_source,q.value key_source
  FROM keys k JOIN types t USING(type_id)
  JOIN elements r ON r.doc_id=t.document_id AND r.module_id=t.module AND r.element_id=t.element
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.element->'keys')='array' THEN r.element->'keys' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) q
  WHERE k.since_rev<=NEW.rev AND (k.retired_rev IS NULL OR k.retired_rev>NEW.rev) AND q.value->>'id'=k.key_id),
 components AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k.type_id,k.key_num,k.umf_version,k.prop_ids,i.ordinal,f.element field_source,p.facets,
   k.key_source-ARRAY['id','name','fields','primary']='{}'::jsonb
    AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(k.key_source->'fields')='array' THEN jsonb_array_length(k.key_source->'fields') END=cardinality(k.prop_ids)
    AND k.key_source->'fields'->(i.ordinal::int-1)=jsonb_build_object('module',p.declaration_module,'element',p.element)
    AND k.record_source->'members' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('module',p.declaration_module,'element',p.element))
    AND f.element IS NOT NULL AND f.element->>'scalarType' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.scalar_type
    AND coalesce(f.element->'facets','{}')=coalesce(p.facets,'{}') qualified
  FROM authored_keys k CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(k.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY i(prop_id,ordinal)
  JOIN properties p ON p.type_id=k.type_id AND p.prop_id=i.prop_id
  LEFT JOIN elements f ON f.doc_id=k.document_id AND f.module_id=p.declaration_module AND f.element_id=p.element),
 codecs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT type_id,key_num,jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-native-key-codec-metadata/0.1',
   'typeId',type_id::text,'keyNumber',key_num::text,'fields',jsonb_agg(field_source ORDER BY ordinal),
   'facets',jsonb_agg(coalesce(facets,'{}') ORDER BY ordinal),'umfVersion',umf_version) metadata
  FROM components GROUP BY type_id,key_num,umf_version,prop_ids
  -- Unsupported accepted forms keep their original lazy key-operation refusal.
  HAVING bool_and(qualified IS TRUE) AND count(*)=cardinality(prop_ids)),
 key_codecs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT type_id,jsonb_object_agg(key_num::text,metadata) metadata FROM codecs GROUP BY type_id),
 property_dependencies AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.type_id,p.prop_id,p.definition_document_id document_id,p.declaration_module module_id
  FROM properties p WHERE p.retired_rev IS NULL OR p.retired_rev>NEW.rev
  UNION
  SELECT p.type_id,p.prop_id,n.value->>'documentId',n.value->'reference'->>'module'
  FROM properties p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(p.item)||coalesce(p.item->'descendants','[]'::jsonb)) n
  WHERE (p.retired_rev IS NULL OR p.retired_rev>NEW.rev) AND p.cardinality IN ('array','map')),
 property_readers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT prop_id,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('documentId',document_id,'moduleId',module_id) ORDER BY document_id,module_id) readers
  FROM property_dependencies GROUP BY prop_id),
 type_readers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT type_id,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('documentId',document_id,'moduleId',module_id) ORDER BY document_id,module_id) readers
  FROM (SELECT type_id,document_id,module module_id FROM types
   UNION SELECT type_id,document_id,module_id FROM property_dependencies) dependencies GROUP BY type_id),
 property_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.type_id,
   coalesce(jsonb_agg(p.prop_id::text ORDER BY p.prop_id) FILTER(WHERE p.since_rev<=NEW.rev),'[]'::jsonb) property_order,
   coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(p.prop_id::text,d.definition_pin) FILTER(WHERE p.since_rev<=NEW.rev),'{}'::jsonb) property_pins,
   coalesce(bool_or(d.definition_pin IS NULL OR p.definition_source_kind<>'accepted_document') FILTER(WHERE p.since_rev<=NEW.rev),false) missing_pins,
   coalesce(bool_and(truss.valid_property_definition(p::truss.prop_def)),true) valid_properties,
   coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(p.prop_id::text,jsonb_build_object(
    'itemsValid',CASE WHEN p.cardinality IN ('array','map') THEN truss.valid_item_chain(p.item) IS TRUE ELSE true END,
    'readers',r.readers)) FILTER(WHERE p.since_rev<=NEW.rev),'{}'::jsonb) property_access,
   jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',jsonb_build_object('documentId',t.document_id,
    'revision',doc.doc_revision,'module',p.declaration_module,'element',p.element),'propertyId',p.prop_id::text) ORDER BY p.prop_id) query_fields
  FROM properties p JOIN types t USING(type_id) JOIN documents doc ON doc.doc_id=t.document_id
  LEFT JOIN property_readers r USING(prop_id)
  LEFT JOIN truss.runtime_definition_source d ON d.rev=p.definition_rev AND d.ord=p.definition_doc_ord
   AND d.doc_id=p.definition_document_id AND d.module_id=p.declaration_module AND d.element_id=p.element AND d.kind='element' AND d.key_id=''
  WHERE p.retired_rev IS NULL OR p.retired_rev>NEW.rev
  GROUP BY p.type_id),
 query_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT type_id,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('keyId',k.key_id,'propertyIds',
   (SELECT jsonb_agg(v.prop_id::text ORDER BY v.ordinal) FROM unnest(k.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY v(prop_id,ordinal))) ORDER BY k.key_num) keys
  FROM keys k WHERE k.retired_rev IS NULL OR k.retired_rev>NEW.rev GROUP BY type_id),
 compiled AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT t.type_id,
   jsonb_build_object('typeId',t.type_id::text,'revision',NEW.rev::text,'typePin',d.definition_pin,
    'propertyOrder',coalesce(p.property_order,'[]'::jsonb),'propertyPins',coalesce(p.property_pins,'{}'::jsonb),
    'propertyAccess',coalesce(p.property_access,'{}'::jsonb),'keyCodecs',coalesce(k.metadata,'{}'::jsonb)) metadata,
   r.readers value_readers,coalesce(p.valid_properties,true) valid_properties,
   coalesce(p.missing_pins,false) OR d.definition_pin IS NULL OR doc.doc_revision IS NULL missing_pins,
   jsonb_build_object('identity',jsonb_build_object('documentId',t.document_id,'revision',doc.doc_revision,'module',t.module,'element',t.element),
    'typeId',t.type_id::text,'keys',coalesce(q.keys,'[]'::jsonb),'fields',coalesce(p.query_fields,'[]'::jsonb)) query_record
  FROM types t LEFT JOIN property_metadata p USING(type_id) LEFT JOIN key_codecs k USING(type_id)
  LEFT JOIN type_readers r USING(type_id) LEFT JOIN query_keys q USING(type_id)
  LEFT JOIN documents doc ON doc.doc_id=t.document_id
  LEFT JOIN truss.runtime_definition_source d ON d.rev=t.definition_rev AND d.ord=t.definition_doc_ord AND d.doc_id=t.definition_document_id
   AND d.module_id=t.module AND d.element_id=t.element AND d.kind='element' AND d.key_id=''),
 inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO truss.runtime_type_schema(rev,type_id,metadata,value_readers,valid_properties)
  SELECT NEW.rev,type_id,metadata,value_readers,valid_properties FROM compiled RETURNING type_id)
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(c.query_record ORDER BY c.type_id),'{}'::jsonb[]),coalesce(bool_or(c.missing_pins),false)
 INTO compiled_records,missing_pins FROM compiled c LEFT JOIN inserted i USING(type_id);
 IF missing_pins THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original compiled schema pins required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF NEW.rev=(SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) THEN
 FOR document_row IN SELECT DISTINCT ON(doc_id) doc_id,doc_revision,content_sha256,document FROM truss.schema_doc WHERE rev<=NEW.rev ORDER BY doc_id,rev DESC LOOP
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(record ORDER BY (record->>'typeId')::int),'[]'::jsonb) INTO records
   FROM unnest(compiled_records) record WHERE record->'identity'->>'documentId'=document_row.doc_id;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',jsonb_build_object('documentId',r.document_id,'revision',document_row.doc_revision,
   'module',r.module,'relationship',r.rel_id),'relationshipTypeId',r.rel_type_id::text,'sourceTypeId',e.source_type::text,'targetTypeId',e.target_type::text)
   ORDER BY r.rel_type_id),'[]'::jsonb),coalesce(bool_and(s.document_id=document_row.doc_id AND t.document_id=document_row.doc_id AND s.kind='record' AND t.kind='record' AND NOT s.provisional AND NOT t.provisional AND s.retired_rev IS NULL AND t.retired_rev IS NULL),true)
   INTO relations,closed FROM truss.rel_def r JOIN truss.rel_endpoint e USING(rel_type_id)
   JOIN truss.type_def s ON s.type_id=e.source_type JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=e.target_type
   WHERE r.document_id=document_row.doc_id AND r.retired_rev IS NULL AND r.lifecycle IN ('independent','owned') AND r.directed
    AND NOT r.composition AND r.assoc_type_id IS NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.rel_endpoint ep WHERE ep.rel_type_id=r.rel_type_id)=1;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('documentId',document_id,'moduleId',module_id) ORDER BY document_id,module_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO readers FROM (
   SELECT document_row.doc_id document_id,m.value->>'id' module_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(document_row.document::jsonb->'modules') m
   UNION SELECT t.document_id,t.module FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.document_id=document_row.doc_id AND t.kind='record' AND t.retired_rev IS NULL
   UNION SELECT p.definition_document_id,p.declaration_module FROM truss.prop_def p JOIN truss.type_def t USING(type_id) WHERE t.document_id=document_row.doc_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL
   UNION SELECT t.document_id,p.declaration_module FROM truss.prop_def p JOIN truss.type_def t USING(type_id) WHERE t.document_id=document_row.doc_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL
   UNION SELECT n.value->>'documentId',n.value->'reference'->>'module' FROM truss.prop_def p JOIN truss.type_def t USING(type_id)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(p.item)||coalesce(p.item->'descendants','[]'::jsonb)) n
    WHERE t.document_id=document_row.doc_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL AND p.cardinality IN ('array','map')) dependencies;
  SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.prop_def p JOIN truss.type_def t USING(type_id)
   WHERE t.document_id=document_row.doc_id AND t.retired_rev IS NULL AND p.retired_rev IS NULL AND p.cardinality IN ('array','map') AND truss.valid_item_chain(p.item) IS NOT TRUE) INTO items_valid;
  INSERT INTO truss.runtime_document_schema VALUES(NEW.rev,document_row.doc_id,jsonb_build_object(
   'pin',jsonb_build_object('documentId',document_row.doc_id,'revision',document_row.doc_revision,'sha256',document_row.content_sha256),
   'records',records,'relationships',relations,'readers',readers,'closed',closed,'itemsValid',items_valid));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_owned_journal_insert_check()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE physical truss.journal%ROWTYPE;claims bigint;matching bigint;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user AND rolsuper) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF NEW.xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR NEW.entity_kind NOT IN ('o','e') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete mutation journal required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT physical FROM truss.journal j WHERE j.at=NEW.at AND j.seq=NEW.seq;
 WITH expected(value) AS (
  SELECT g.expected_members->m.operation_index->'journal'
  FROM truss.runtime_create_member m JOIN truss.runtime_create_group g USING(group_id)
